class.name: LRTVolume3D
class.description:
Owns one [LRTVolume] and everything around it: it reads its inputs from the scene (MeshInstance3D receivers, Light3D lights and the WorldEnvironment sky), bakes the prototype's Color SDF local field on a worker thread, injects the direct-light source term, propagates the 26-neighbor RGB SH4 transport and draws the migrated diffuse result on the scene's own standard materials. The node is the only thing a scene needs — opening it in the editor previews the same field the running game uses — and every prototype input and display choice is an inspector property that is saved with the scene.
The probe grid lives in world axes and is centred on the node's own position, so the node may be moved and sized but not rotated or non-uniformly scaled; that is reported as a configuration warning. The editor draws the volume box with the same gizmo as a ReflectionProbe and the six face handles resize it, where a drag suppresses the bake and releasing the handle bakes once for the final box.

method.name: get_build_stats
method.description: Probe, receiver and timing counters of the last applied bake.

method.name: get_cancelled_builds
method.description: Number of background bakes that were superseded and thrown away.

method.name: get_dropped_builds
method.description: Number of finished bakes that were discarded because a newer one already existed.

method.name: get_error_message
method.description: Last configuration or build error, or an empty string.

method.name: get_geometry_builds
method.description: Number of local fields this node has built and applied.

method.name: get_solver
method.description: The underlying solver, for diagnostics and parity checks.

method.name: get_volume_warnings
method.description: Transform restrictions of this volume (rotation, non-uniform scale).

method.name: is_building
method.description: Whether a background bake is currently running.

method.name: poll
method.description: Runs one frame of the node's own logic immediately: input refresh, a finished background bake and, when unpaused, one propagation round. Scripts and headless tools use it to drive the volume without waiting for frames.

method.name: rebuild
method.description: Collects the scene inputs and starts a background bake now.

method.name: reset_field
method.description: Clears radiance, visibility and the iteration history, and stays paused.

method.name: set_rebuild_suppressed
method.description: Holds rebuilds while an editor drag resizes the volume; releasing it bakes once for the final state.

method.name: step
method.description: Runs the given number of propagation rounds and stays paused.

members.member: Whether the surface reconstruction weights the 27 candidate probes with the prototype's quadratic B-spline (enabled) or takes the nearest valid probe (disabled, for diagnosis).
Whether the volume also builds and draws while the scene is open in the editor.
Master switch. When disabled the overlays are removed, the engine's own lights and environment are restored and only the engine result is shown.
Whether the probe region is expanded to cover imported geometry with the prototype's two air cells. Box-only scenes keep the volume box itself, as the prototype does.
Display exposure, applied to the prototype display curve and the slice view.
[code]Color SDF[/code] (prototype default) or the prototype's [code]Analytic boxes[/code] path, which only accepts axis-aligned boxes.
Subtree the receivers and lights are collected from. Empty uses the node's parent.
Propagation rounds per frame while unpaused. Zero stops automatic propagation.
Longest-axis resolution of the per-asset Color SDF for imported meshes. Boxes keep the prototype's fixed 24.
Whether the transferred radiance is reflected again each round (the prototype's bounce term).
What the viewport shows: full lighting, direct only, indirect only, sky visibility, or one of the three probe slices.
Paused volumes keep the field until [method step] or [method reset_field] is called.
Whether the environment is switched to a Reinhard curve with white 128 while the volume is shown, approximating the prototype's [code]x/(1+x)[/code] display.
Height of the probe slice views.
Probe spacing in metres: the grid resolution, the h/2 surface band and the reach of one propagation round.
[code]SH triple product[/code] (prototype default) or the [code]26-direction mask[/code] occlusion path.
Size of the probe region, centred on the node's position.
